suite_name: GSTFlow Synthetic Marketplace GST Test Suite
important_notice: All rows and identifiers are fabricated for software testing. They are not Amazon exports, real taxpayer data, real GSTIN registrations, tax advice, or filing-ready returns.

amazon/synthetic_amazon_credit_notes.csv.purpose: Synthetic credit-note records linked to synthetic invoices

edge_cases/synthetic_invalid_transaction.purpose: Controlled invalid data with expected issue labels

schema_caveat: Column names are a GSTFlow canonical test schema inspired by publicly described marketplace/MTR fields. They are not claimed to match Amazon's exact downloadable MTR CSV headers.
tax_caveat: Tax arithmetic is internally generated for test scenarios. Tax rates and statutory treatment must be confirmed against current law and a GST professional before production use.
gstin_caveat: GSTIN-like values are synthetic format-shaped identifiers only. Registration status and checksum validity are not asserted.
